design: One short factual question, answered both as Choice yes/no and native Noul on identical state. Compare the unchanged v5 selected window with the entire selected source PDF. One guided-page control tests the known missing affordability passage. These are AI-authored diagnostic expectations, frozen before calls; they are not original human codes, a holdout, or population accuracy. A no means the supplied text does not establish the proposition. No production label changes.

criteria.no: The supplied text does not state this.

questions.question: Does `report.text` explicitly mention infrastructure?
questions.reference_quote: concerns with the infrastructure
questions.reason: Literal presence control.

questions.question: Does `report.text` say Community Board 8 raised concerns about infrastructure?
questions.reference_quote: Community Board 8's members cited concerns with the infrastructure
questions.reason: Directly attributed concern; no specific service must be named.

questions.question: Does `report.text` say Community Board 8 raised concerns about residents being displaced?
questions.reference_quote: not enough affordable housing for the project
questions.reason: An affordable-housing concern does not establish displacement.

questions.question: Does `report.text` record a commissioner asking whether DPR was at full capacity at the proposed location?
questions.reference_quote: regarding if DPR was at full capacity in the proposed location
questions.reason: Explicit question about public-facility capacity.

questions.question: Does `report.text` say DPR has already installed the requested flagpole?
questions.reference_quote: the flag pole is a capital expense and DPR will have to make
questions.reason: A future capital request does not establish completed installation.

questions.question: Does `report.text` say the City Planning Commission expressed concerns about affordability?
questions.reference_quote: The Commission reiterates its concerns about affordability
questions.reason: The earlier selected window ends on page 8, before this direct concern.

questions.question: Does `report.text` describe a proposal for one hundred percent income-restricted housing?
questions.reference_quote: make the project one hundred percent income restricted
questions.reason: Topic discussion is present before the CPC concern appears.

questions.question: Does `report.text` say the applicant has already secured subsidies for one hundred percent income-restricted housing?
questions.reference_quote: contingent on receiving subsidies from the city and state
questions.reason: A contingent proposal is not secured financing.

questions.question: Does `report.text` say Community Board 4 recommended reducing parking from 35 to 23 spaces?
questions.reference_quote: Parking will be reduced from 35 to 23 spaces
questions.reason: This appears in the board's recommendation conditions.

questions.question: Does `report.text` say Community Board 4 recommended reducing the building height?
questions.reference_quote: The proposed heights of the building will be reduced from 164 feet
questions.reason: The board's conditional support still establishes a request.

questions.question: Does `report.text` say the applicant agreed to reduce the building height after certification?
questions.reference_quote: agreed to modify its proposal to reduce the height of the building from 164 feet to 154 feet
questions.reason: The board's request alone does not establish later applicant acceptance.

questions.question: Does `report.text` say the building was already 154 feet tall in the proposal as originally certified?
questions.reference_quote: The building would have risen to a height of 164 feet
questions.reason: The earlier proposal was 164 feet, not the revised 154 feet.

questions.question: Does `report.text` say the Borough President recommended meeting space for tenants?
questions.reference_quote: in response to the Queens Borough President’s recommendation
questions.reason: The commitment is expressly linked to the recommendation.

questions.question: Does `report.text` say the applicant committed to provide meeting space for tenants?
questions.reference_quote: the applicant has committed to provide meeting space within the building for tenants
questions.reason: Explicit applicant commitment.

questions.question: Does `report.text` say providing meeting space is a condition of CPC approval?
questions.reference_quote: it is not a condition of this action
questions.reason: The report expressly distinguishes commitment from an approval condition.

questions.question: Does `report.text` say tenants raised concerns about plumbing or electrical systems?
questions.reference_quote: additional burden the new units would place on the development's plumbing and electrical systems
questions.reason: Specific infrastructure concern.

questions.question: Does `report.text` say tenants raised concerns about being evicted or displaced?
questions.reference_quote: Twelve speakers, tenants of the Gardens at Forest Hills, spoke against the proposed rezoning
questions.reason: Tenant objections concern amenities and services; displacement is not stated.

questions.question: Does `report.text` say tenants raised concerns about playgrounds or seating areas?
questions.reference_quote: lack of playground facilities for young children and the lack of seating areas
questions.reason: Positive environmental/open-space control in the same tenant passage.

questions.question: Does `report.text` say the applicant agreed to a restrictive declaration limiting the site to 412 dwelling units?
questions.reference_quote: would limit the number of dwelling units on the site to 412
questions.reason: Specific accepted density restriction, not a bare declaration reference.

questions.question: Does `report.text` say adding the 44 dwelling units would increase the buildings' height?
questions.reference_quote: The additional units would not add to the height
questions.reason: Explicit negative physical-scale control.

questions.question: Does `report.text` say CPC requested a planted buffer near residential districts?
questions.reference_quote: The City Planning Commission has requested that
questions.reason: The following text specifies the planted strip.

questions.question: Does `report.text` say the Public Development Corporation agreed to add the planted-buffer provision to the urban renewal plan?
questions.reference_quote: the Public Development Corporation agreed to add this provision to the urban renewal plan
questions.reason: Accepted environmental/design provision.

questions.question: Does `report.text` say the planted-buffer provision protects tenants against eviction?
questions.reference_quote: a year-round dense buffer at least six feet high within three years
questions.reason: The physical buffer is not an eviction protection.

questions.question: Does `report.text` describe a requirement to relocate bus stops to Sheffield Avenue?
questions.reference_quote: Relocate bus stops off of Pennsylvania Avenue to Sheffield Avenue
questions.reason: Specific transit-related condition.

questions.question: Does `report.text` say these environmental conditions came from an earlier approval in 1985?
questions.reference_quote: previously approved on August 19, 1985
questions.reason: Prior condition is not a newly negotiated concession in 1987.
